scientific_integrity: Exact symbolic arguments supply the infinite-parameter results; finite checker output is only corroboration. Self-review is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed propositional truth sets, all-row or nonempty-row accessibility, and semantically realizable content sets; not arbitrary modal contraction, nor stronger frame axioms. General transformation-semigroup equivalences remain a historical-priority risk.
title: Factual hedged contractions generate left-regular bands with sharp ranks
